discovery.limitation: A descriptor is not proof that its provider is reachable or truthful.

executability.source: Current local execution policy and destructive-approval configuration
executability.limitation: Passing local policy does not establish credentials, program authority, sandbox availability, valid inputs or service reachability. No operation is executed by this view.

authority.source: No independent exact-action boundary decision attached to this observation
authority.limitation: Discovery, composition and publication grant no authority. A principal, exact action, parameters and protected boundary must be authorised separately. Other shells, tools and credentials are outside this view.

assurance.source: Latest retained execution/composition observation, not a publication trust label
assurance.limitation: Applies only to that historical run. Predicates are local checks. A separate read-only witness provider is not necessarily an independent organisation or a complete business-outcome oracle; receipt hashes are not external attestations.

reusability.source: Matching current graph descriptor and retained goal/pipeline
reusability.limitation: Retention does not establish usefulness, current validity, authority or actual fresh-agent reuse.

validity.source: Current contract change detectors compared with the latest retained run's dependency references
validity.limitation: Non-cryptographic descriptor comparison is not proof of unchanged behaviour. Missing/truncated history stays unassessed; remote behaviour may change without a descriptor change.
